item.description: ViRA proposes Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization to train ultra-high-resolution visual reasoning agents on contrast sets.

item.title: [paper] How VLMs Plan What's Next

item.title: [paper] Hyperlyve: Parallelized Enumeration and Exact Lyapunov Stability Certification for Deep ReLU Networks
item.description: Hyperlyve is a framework that proves asymptotic stability of nonlinear dynamical systems and neural network controllers using parallel ReLU enumeration.

item.title: [paper] Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting with Physics-Indexed Specialist Memory: the Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent
item.description: The Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent combines evolutionary search and Bayesian policy reuse to adapt in non-stationary environments while retaining past performance.

item.title: [paper] Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging
item.description: A bagging-based learning algorithm outputs a majority vote of autoregressive generators to achieve optimal sample complexity for chain-of-thought learning.

item.title: [paper] SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
item.description: SADL is a loss function that constrains the encoder directly based on demand-supply geometry to prevent representation collapse in joint-embedding predictive architectures.

item.title: [paper] Surrogate-Assisted Compact-Model Extraction for SKY130 CMOS at 77 K
item.description: A surrogate-assisted extraction method fits BSIM4 transistor parameters to measured low-temperature data for cryogenic circuit design in standard simulators.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
item.description: Two deep learning methods analyze early-career job advertisements using transformer representations, semantic clustering, and sparse autoencoders to interpret role differences.

item.title: [paper] CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts
item.description: CertiSum is a method that ensures bitwise-identical MXFP4 training across different hardware platforms and parallelism layouts.

item.title: [paper] ScenarioForge: Resource-Grounded Generation and Execution Validation of Cyber Exercises
item.description: ScenarioForge translates high-level requirements into resource-grounded cyber exercises and validates them using the Common Open Research Emulator.

item.title: [paper] When Tool Names Are Not Identities: Measuring Provider Misbinding in MCP-Based AI Agents
item.description: Study analyzing tool-provider misbinding in Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents, showing how metadata overlaps allow attacker-controlled tools to intercept requests intended for legitimate providers.

item.title: [paper] DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions
item.description: Model-agnostic explainability framework called DynSurvX that uses a hierarchical two-phase Shapley value strategy to provide time-resolved explanations for dynamic survival predictions with mixed static and longitudinal data.

item.title: [paper] When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
item.description: Study benchmarking test-time augmentation across histology and general-purpose foundation models, finding that entropy routing selectively applies augmentation to uncertain predictions to eliminate computational overhead while retaining performance gains.

item.title: [paper] Wildfire-SSR: Geolocation-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Structure-Level Wildfire Risk Assessment
item.description: Wildfire-SSR is a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence using a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder for structure-level wildfire risk assessment.

item.title: [paper] Severe but Harmless: Stress-Testing Shift Severity for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
item.description: Study investigating time-series distribution shift severity measures, demonstrating through systematic experiments that standard statistical measures do not reliably predict performance degradation for instance-normalized forecasting foundation models.

item.title: [repo] sybil-solutions/inference-optimisation-skill
item.description: An agent skill optimizes local LLM serving speeds across different hardware and quantization levels while maintaining context stability.

item.title: [paper] Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction
item.description: Reference Forcing is a long video generation method that uses initial frames as an appearance reference and value correction in the KV cache to maintain subject and background consistency over time.

item.title: [paper] Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
item.description: Study measuring temporal contamination in language models by comparing modern models to chronologically constrained models, revealing that apparent forecasting skill often stems from historical memory rather than real-time economic reasoning.

item.title: [paper] BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
item.description: BLIP-Live is an interactive streaming video framework using the BLIP-Live-780K dataset and PAUC-F metric to balance timeliness and firing precision for proactive video agent responses.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarking memory and nonlinear processing capacity of quantum recurrent neural networks for time series prediction
item.description: Benchmark of variational quantum recurrent neural networks on time series prediction tasks, evaluating memory and nonlinear processing capacity against classical recurrent baselines across different architectures.

item.title: [paper] ONAM: Fitting Orthogonal Neural Additive Models for Post-Hoc Interpretability of Black-Box Predictions
item.description: The R package ONAM implements orthogonal neural additive models for post-hoc interpretability, using functional decomposition to reliably break black-box model predictions into uniquely defined, hierarchically orthogonal feature components.

item.title: [paper] TRACE: Topological Representations for Anomaly detection through Contrastive Embeddings
item.description: TRACE is a topology-aware graph contrastive learning framework that improves label-efficient intrusion detection by learning from benign system-activity graphs.

item.title: [paper] Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests
item.description: Evaluating recourse in language model explanations reveals that single correct reasons in multi-rule denials frequently fail to provide valid recourse for users.

item.title: [paper] The cost of enforcing long-run coverage: a phase transition in online conformal prediction
item.description: Online conformal prediction algorithms face a fundamental trade-off between minimizing instantaneous coverage errors and enforcing long-run empirical coverage guarantees under adversarial conditions.

item.title: [paper] SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
item.description: SciResearch-Eval is an interactive benchmark that evaluates scientific judgment and calibration in autonomous experimental agents using a deliberately flawed simulator.

item.title: [paper] Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
item.description: Targeted interventions in specific attention heads of vision-language models can locate and repair cross-image comparison failures without extensive parameter updates.

item.title: [paper] Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
item.description: Reinforcement learning with imperfect verifiers is vulnerable to reward hacking and optimization failure across various proxy types and error axes.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
item.description: Diagnostic evaluation protocols combining human annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbations reveal sentiment analysis robustness failures in language models.

item.title: [paper] How Much Does Saliency Accuracy Matter for Saliency-Guided 360-degree Image Compression?
item.description: Lightweight saliency predictors can achieve substantial bit-rate savings in 360-degree image compression, offering a practical choice for latency-constrained streaming applications.

item.title: [paper] DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
item.description: DuoFlow is a dual-stream latent flow transformer that generates synchronized speech and motion sequences with fine-grained control over vocal style and body movements.

item.title: [paper] Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
item.description: Small language models fine-tuned on exact verifier traces learn fixed inquiry schedules that successfully generate sufficient explanations but struggle to generalize to unseen policies.

item.title: [paper] Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Safe Algorithm Distillation uses a budget-aware teacher and a test-time adjustment to improve adaptation and reduce cost in safe reinforcement learning tasks.

item.title: [paper] Safe Resemblance, Silent Propagation: Limits of Text-Similarity Guardrails for AI Agent Safety
item.description: Text-similarity guardrails for AI agents often conflate legitimate quotation with malicious instruction propagation, resulting in high false alert rates and missed functional outputs.

item.title: [paper] Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
item.description: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings largely measures text length rather than discourse homogenization, leading to widespread artifacts in temporal analysis.

item.title: [paper] Lazy-MOSAIC: Accelerating Skill-Centric Manipulation Planning with Learned Skill-Effect World Models
item.description: Lazy-MOSAIC uses a cheap learned world model to predict skill outcomes and focus expensive simulation on promising candidates, significantly accelerating long-horizon manipulation planning.

item.title: [paper] Tensorized Automata: Algebraically Informed Representation Learning for Sequential Decision Making
item.description: Tensorized automata use alternating finite automata semantics and message passing to learn compact control features and execution operators for sequential decision making.

item.title: [paper] Almost Controlled: The FDR of Benjamini-Hochberg on Weighted Conformal p-Values
item.description: The Benjamini-Hochberg procedure can exceed its target false discovery rate when applied to weighted conformal p-values, with the excess bounded by specific finite-sample formulas.

item.title: [paper] GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR
item.description: GHySSeg is a fast, training-free geometric method that segments ground and road surfaces from hybrid solid-state LiDAR frames by tracing individual scan curves.

item.title: [paper] Leverage-Enhanced Sampling Owen Method for Explainable Artificial Intelligence
item.description: Leverage-enhanced sampling within Owen's multilinear extension framework reduces the computational cost of estimating Shapley values for machine learning model explainability.

item.title: [paper] Learning from Duality in Neural Network Field Theories
item.description: Neural network field theories use Wakimoto and Fourier-Berezin fields to realize Wess-Zumino-Witten models, connecting exact conformal field theory structures with neural representation properties.

item.title: [news] 5 Things That Break When AI Agents Start Acting on Their Own
item.description: Governance problems such as unmanaged access, identity sprawl, approval bottlenecks, and manual oversight emerge when AI agents begin taking real-world actions on their own.

item.title: [paper] The CYBER-BRIDGE project: An AI-Powered Platform for Cross-Border Cybersecurity, Compliance and Forensics in the EU
item.description: The CYBER-BRIDGE project introduces an AI-powered platform that integrates cross-border cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and digital forensics under a unified hash-chained evidence architecture.

item.title: [paper] Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision--Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation
item.description: A risk-aware semantic watermarking framework dynamically allocates watermark strength during vision-language model decoding to improve the trade-off between detection accuracy and response quality.

item.title: [paper] Differentiable Exact Learning
item.description: Differentiable Finite-State Transducers couple an external environment to a state-tracking neural controller to achieve extreme length generalization on arithmetic and universal-simulation tasks from small datasets.

item.title: [paper] Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
item.description: ReSpaceBench evaluates the persistent spatial memory of embodied agents across repeated room visits, revealing that existing models and agentic frameworks struggle with room association and state tracking.

item.title: [paper] RESILAGENT: A Three-Pillar Architecture for Cyber-Physical Resilience in Electrical Power and Energy Systems
item.description: RESILAGENT proposes a three-pillar architecture combining agentic AI, digital twins, and blockchain to detect and recover from hybrid cyber-physical threats in electrical power systems.

item.title: [paper] LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
item.description: LynnReal-Hand introduces a hand-controlled video world model that unifies fine-grained hand-object interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation for interactive environments.

item.title: [paper] Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
item.description: Jetriever ranks stored memories by utility scoring rather than similarity, improving retrieval accuracy for agent memory systems and question-answering tasks.

item.title: [paper] Generative AI and the Crisis of Higher Education Assessments: Examining 'AI-Proofing' Strategies for College-Level Assessments
item.description: An analysis of college-level assessments across multiple disciplines evaluates how state-of-the-art large language models perform on questions purposely designed by faculty members to be AI-resistant.

item.title: [paper] Network Intrusion Detection Adaptability under Spurious Labels: A Noise-Aware Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning Framework
item.description: NAFN is a noise-aware few-shot class-incremental learning framework that identifies mislabeled data and resamples synthetic features to help network intrusion detection systems adapt to new attacks.

item.title: [paper] Event-Triggered Visual Perception for Real-Time Harvest Outcome Estimation in Mechanical Blueberry Harvesting
item.description: An event-triggered machine-vision system captures and analyzes crate images locally on an industrial computer to provide real-time maturity estimates of mechanically harvested blueberries.

item.title: [paper] Subprocess-Constrained Markov Decision Processes
item.description: Subprocess-constrained Markov decision processes introduce a stronger feasibility requirement for policies, and a polynomial-time algorithm using history-dependent policies overcomes the resulting computational obstacles.

item.title: [paper] Variationally correct physics-informed operator learning for nonlinear partial differential equations
item.description: Variationally correct physics-informed operator learning uses first-order system least-squares residuals to train neural operators for nonlinear partial differential equations without requiring labeled solution data.

item.title: [paper] Generative Data Augmentation Without External Data: An Empirical and Theoretical Study on Deep Networks
item.description: Generative data augmentation without external data can improve classifier test accuracy when the real and generated distributions have a small discrepancy and the baseline classifier has room for improvement.

item.title: [paper] Warm Starting Neural Dynamics Models From Few Jacobian Samples
item.description: TDec-Init is an algorithm that warm-starts neural dynamics models using transition Jacobians decomposed from stacked tensor samples to improve sample efficiency in reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] ExRel: Learning Directed Reuse Relevance between Rich-Text K-12 Question Images with Executable Relation Contracts
item.description: ExRel is an agentic, code-grounded framework for synthesizing and validating educational question images to improve directed reuse relevance grading in K-12 learning tasks.

item.title: [paper] Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
item.description: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization uses factorized model structures and balancing techniques to simultaneously lower inference latency and increase learning capacity in multimodal large language models.

item.title: [paper] A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
item.description: Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning is a framework that models demographic disagreements in annotation tasks to improve group-level performance in toxicity detection without requiring privacy-invasive individual details.

item.title: [paper] Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
item.description: Compact visual latents encode high-resolution remote sensing crops into short memory sequences, retaining fine-grained local evidence for multimodal large language models while compressing context.

item.title: [paper] Expertise capture in workplace AI
item.description: Expertise capture is a conceptual framework describing how knowledge workers' professional judgments are absorbed into AI resources under organizational control and retained when workers depart.

item.title: [paper] Comments on "Deep Fréchet Regression"
item.description: Conditional flow matching offers an alternative perspective to deep Fréchet regression by learning covariate-dependent transport directly within the response space for modeling full conditional distributions.

item.title: [paper] Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers
item.description: Evaluation study showing that frontier large language models can directly compile programs into neural network weights and read raw weights to analyze small networks.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
item.description: Training framework that optimizes reasoning in generative recommendation models using predictive gain to provide contribution-aware rewards for individual reasoning steps.

item.title: [paper] [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
item.description: Cross-modal enhancement method that leverages local visual patches and textual tokens from CLIP to improve class-incremental learning while preserving previous knowledge.

item.title: [paper] A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
item.description: Reinforcement learning method that navigates high-dimensional particle physics parameter spaces to efficiently discover diverse, high-quality Standard Model Effective Field Theory hypotheses.

item.title: [paper] Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
item.description: Comparison of segmentation and RANSAC detection methods on airborne LiDAR point clouds to accurately isolate and identify individual power lines across varying terrain.

item.title: [paper] Variational Monte Carlo for Quantum Excited States via Nested Low-Rank Approximation
item.description: Variational Monte Carlo algorithm that computes molecular quantum excited states using a low-rank approximation reparameterization to overcome exponential scaling hurdles.

item.title: [paper] Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits
item.description: Study showing that replacing a linear program with a simple sorting strategy for weight-space programming edits maintains high performance on language math tasks.

item.title: [paper] Emergent Steering Beyond Endpoint Alignment in Chemical Reaction Models
item.description: Unified forward-retrosynthesis framework that uses shared latent space geometry to decompose chemical reaction model updates into endpoint-parallel and residual components for auditing.
